description: Enrich one existing initiative within a program. Prefer initiativeId; repoFullName is allowed only when that repository has one initiative in the program. Pass appendContext for factual context, or change description/priority. A description change on an ICE-spec initiative is rejected with the revise_program_initiative_scope replacement. The result reports changed fields or a structured no-op.

appendContext.description: Factual context to append, maximum 4000 characters.

description.description: Replacement objective; not allowed for spec-required initiatives.

initiativeId.description: Exact initiative id; preferred when available.

repoFullName.description: owner/name repository selector when it is unique in the program.

name: anyforge_update_program_initiative
title: Update program initiative
